scope: New analytic projected pixel measurements, not RGB-rendered detector outputs, not DA3 predictions, not independent real objects. No scores observed when this design was written.

assumptions.measurements: Sparse background pixel tracks plus rod endpoint observations are synthesized from latent geometry and stated noise/mismatch processes; no image detector or matching quality is claimed.
assumptions.known_cross_view_endpoint_correspondence: Each declared segment supplies two endpoint tracks. Shared endpoint identity across images is an explicit analytic assumption, except the declared wrong-association cases.
assumptions.initialization: Initial K/E are preregistered synthetic perturbations of latent cameras. The initial values are not exact cameras and are not actual DA3 predictions. Principal point is the assumed image center.
assumptions.split: Training requires every noisy observation y>=192; validation requires every noisy observation y<128. Neither split nor leave-groups use GT residuals.
assumptions.identity: Anonymous ids do not prove physical target identity. Coherent wrong-rod cases deliberately expose this limit.
assumptions.evaluation: Keep rod_segments in the same declared order as rod_tracks. Reuse a single full-control camera-only Sim3 for all folds; no per-fold GT alignment to shrink the envelope. Degenerate alignment must be explicit missing.
assumptions.acceptance: No universal pass/fail threshold is fit on this new suite. Informative, stress, missing and unidentifiable roles are declared before running algorithms.

cases.expected_limit: Informative background and wide baseline; reference control, no promise of a particular numerical score.
Farther rod amplifies angular error; envelope is an empirical sensitivity diagnostic.
Larger independent measurement noise; do not require every random instance to rank monotonically.
Combined depth and pixel-noise stress; no post-hoc threshold fitting.
Single-depth background weakens calibration evidence; not guaranteed to produce a failure.
Distant planar background and nearer target probe calibration transfer; a small envelope is not a certificate.
Single-depth background with a farther target; report geometry error separately from spread.
Whole camera layout scaled down tenfold while noncollinearity ratio is preserved.
Combined narrow baseline, distant rod and noise; uncertainty may be large or deceptively small.
Two declared finite segments; known endpoint correspondence and segment order are analytic assumptions.
All views consistently measure a parallel wrong rod displaced by 0.12m. Stability may remain high while target accuracy is wrong.
All views consistently measure a rod at 1.25x target depth. Fixed wrong correspondences may be stable; the envelope need not detect this.
One fixed per-frame pixel shift affects background and rod alike. Training resampling cannot guarantee detection of shared systematic bias.
Endpoint identities are exchanged in view 2. Wrong pixels remain fixed in every fold; spread is not a correspondence validator.
Each rod endpoint has only one view; no triangulated rod output is admissible.
No training, validation or rod observations. Group fitting must explicitly skip and rod geometry must remain absent.
